text:
rita (AE): Heads-up — Prospect 'HelioTrust' wants pre-sales: SSO (SAML), SCIM bulk + PATCH, RBAC mapping, delegated domain verification (no TXT allowed), and an on-prem connector to talk to their HSM. Need feasibility + rough pricing.

dan (SE): Clarifying: SCIM peak rate? full exports or deltas? SP-initiated preferred?

rita (AE): ~15k users, spikes ~150/min during sync jobs. Deltas + PATCH required. SP-initiated but they will do IdP in a few apps.

priya (Solutions): For that profile Hosted with burst buffer is plausible, but reserved Dedicated gives predictable throughput for delta-heavy jobs. Will run a pricing scenario for both (monthly + 1yr reserved).

amir (Security): They need customer-managed KMS and mTLS for the on-prem connector. Also require audit logs to ship to their SIEM and evidence of key rotation policies. Private deploy needed for air-gapped HSM.

dan (SE): RBAC note: we map SCIM groups to roles; nested groups flatten into memberships in the POC. If they need nested-role semantics enforced, app-side checks required.

infra-bot: :gear: SCIM staging endpoint v2 ready; sample PATCH available on request.

rita (AE): Action items: priya to price Dedicated vs Hosted w/ burst; amir to draft KMS/HSM controls and export options; dan to prepare POC checklist + sample PATCH payload. I'll schedule a 30m technical call with HelioTrust.
